shortcut.example: E.g. Ctrl + Shift + F9. Esc cancels.
shortcut.taken: Another program already uses that shortcut, so it doesn't work. Pick another one.

gamesHint: The overlay only shows over games: the ones Aureum knows, the ones you added in Activity and the ones you add here. Launchers and clients (Steam, Riot Client, Epic etc.) never count. For that, Aureum checks only the name of the program in the foreground and the monitor it's on, once a second during a call or while a notification is on screen; none of it leaves your PC.
hideInHint: The overlay doesn't show over these games.
blackBox: Your Windows shows the overlay as a black box in streams; it will be hidden while you stream.
enableHint: During a call, shows who's in it over the game. Shows only when a game is in the foreground; never over browsers, launchers or other apps.
shortcuts: Shortcuts (they work with Aureum in the background)
shortcutsHint: Some games block Windows shortcuts. To work in them, during a call with the overlay on, Aureum checks only the keys of these two shortcuts. No other key is read and nothing is recorded.
hiddenWhileSharing: The overlay stays hidden while you share your screen.
editHint: Each widget has its own position and size, and the overlay shows on the game's monitor. In edit mode, drag each widget to move it and pull the corner to resize (on cameras, the corner changes each camera's size, and the top bar changes the layout and the count); the position is saved for that monitor. Esc or Done finishes.
voiceHint: Who's in the call, with a ring on whoever is speaking and muted and deafened icons.
onlySpeakingHint: Hides people who are silent; a person disappears shortly after they stop speaking.
camerasHint: Shows only when someone has their camera on, including you. People with a camera leave the voice list and come here.
notificationsHint: Direct messages, mentions, incoming calls and who joins or leaves the call, for about 5 seconds. Outside calls too, over games. Nothing shows in Do not disturb.
hideContentHint: Shows only who sent it, like “@someone sent you a message”.
windowedOnly: Works with games in windowed or borderless window mode. In exclusive full screen, Windows doesn't let other windows show on top. Aureum doesn't touch the game (no injection), and the overlay doesn't show in captures. While you stream the whole screen or the game, it stays hidden.

cameras.overflowHint: Past the maximum, the last camera shows “+N”. Whoever is speaking always shows. The widget's box grows and shrinks with the cameras, from the screen corner it's in.
